rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Executes code in ephemeral unikernel sandboxes with declarative policy-based security controls, providing isolated execution environments for untrusted code. Provides tools for code execution, run inspection, and environment diagnostics. TypeScript with stdio transport, integrating with Claude Code, Cursor, and VSCode.
